name: Elkies Rank-18 First Cover
curve_family_name: Elkies 2026 first rank-18 quadratic cover over Q(r)
description: Elkies's first quadratic base change u^2=4225*t^2+38636*t+289444, rationally parameterized over Q(r), with P01..P17 pulled back from the published rank-17 K3 and an independently exact-verified anti-invariant P18.

provenance.author: Noam D. Elkies
provenance.paper: An elliptic K3 surface X/Q(t) with Mordell-Weil rank 17 I: Formulas for X and base changes of ranks 18 and 19
provenance.rank18_status: verified generic lower bound 18: equation (11) is the published quadratic base change; P01..P17 pull back from the released rank-17 family and recovered P18 is exact on Q(t,u), non-Galois-invariant, and has an exact verified trace relation to the published basis
provenance.p18_recovery: recovered coordinates are not printed in Elkies's paper; Rank Hunter independently verifies the exact quadratic-cover Weierstrass identity, non-invariance under u -> -u, trace relation to P01..P17, and rational parameterization
provenance.published_claim: Elkies proves that the fibration has quadratic base changes of rank at least 18 and gives equation (11) as one of the simplest such rational quadratic base changes.
provenance.rank17_dependency: Requires the released Elkies Rank-17 K3 package for the exact published base surface and P01..P17 formulas.
